description.en: Saskatchewan is a province in Western Canada. It is bordered to the west by Alberta, to the north by the Northwest Territories, to the east by Manitoba, to the northeast by Nunavut, and to the south by the United States .
description.zh-CN: 薩克其萬省，簡稱薩省或沙省，是加拿大的一級行政區，首府設於雷吉納。薩克其萬於1905年成立，與隔鄰的亞伯達省和曼尼托巴省合稱草原三省。
